description: This file defines the Vtiger_DependencyPicklist class, which manages dependent picklist fields in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving, saving, deleting dependencies, and generating dependency data sources.

classes.name: Vtiger_DependencyPicklist
classes.description: Class for managing dependent picklist fields in vtiger CRM, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and dependency checks.

methods.name: getDependentPicklistFields
methods.description: Retrieves dependent picklist fields for a given module or all modules if none specified.

methods.name: getAvailablePicklists
methods.description: Returns available picklist fields for a specified module.

methods.name: savePickListDependencies
methods.description: Saves or updates picklist dependencies based on provided dependency map.

methods.name: deletePickListDependencies
methods.description: Deletes dependencies between source and target fields for a module.

methods.name: getPickListDependency
methods.description: Retrieves dependency mapping for specified source and target fields.

methods.name: getPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Generates data source array for picklist dependencies for a module.

methods.name: getJSPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Returns JSON-encoded dependency data source for a module.

methods.name: checkCyclicDependency
methods.description: Checks for cyclic dependencies between picklist fields in a module.

methods.name: getDependentPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves modules that have dependent picklist fields.
